notes: *neither* fuses the waw with the לֹא of the same clause across the intervening material (rule 35), headed on the negative; גַּם is left unrendered because *neither* carries nothing of its sense (rule 30).
לָהֶם is silenced by the ASV's recasting, both preposition and suffix going unrepresented (rule 40, closing).

*any remembrance* is a supplied quantifying determiner on the bare noun (rule 15), no כֹּל standing in the clause; לָאַחֲרֹנָה fuses to the single *after*, leaving its separately segmented article unrepresented (rule 30).
